# Sharkey Media

> Sharkey Media is a digital media and marketing company providing web design, SEO, web hosting, media production, digital strategy, and related digital services.

## Core Pages

- [Sharkey Media](https://sharkeymedia.com/): Main website and overview of Sharkey Media's digital services and capabilities.
- [About / Our People](https://sharkeymedia.com/our-people/): Information about the people behind Sharkey Media.
- [Partners](https://sharkeymedia.com/partners/): Information about Sharkey Media's partners and business relationships.
- [Contact Us](https://sharkeymedia.com/contact-us/): Contact information and inquiry options for Sharkey Media.

## Services

- [Capabilities](https://sharkeymedia.com/capabilities/): Overview of Sharkey Media's digital capabilities and services.
- [Web Design](https://sharkeymedia.com/web-design/): Information about Sharkey Media's web design services.
- [Web Hosting & SEO](https://sharkeymedia.com/web-hosting-seo/): Information about web hosting and SEO services.
- [Media Production](https://sharkeymedia.com/media-production/): Information about Sharkey Media's media production services.

## Portfolio & Case Studies

- [Case Studies](https://sharkeymedia.com/case-studies/): Examples of Sharkey Media projects, client work, and results.
- [Portfolios](https://sharkeymedia.com/portfolios/): Collection of Sharkey Media's portfolio projects and client work.

## Media

- [Media](https://sharkeymedia.com/media/): Sharkey Media's media, news, interviews, podcasts, and other published content.

## Recommended Pages for Context

For an overview of Sharkey Media, start with the [homepage](https://sharkeymedia.com/), [Capabilities](https://sharkeymedia.com/capabilities/), and [Our People](https://sharkeymedia.com/our-people/) pages.

For examples of client work, refer to the [Case Studies](https://sharkeymedia.com/case-studies/) and [Portfolios](https://sharkeymedia.com/portfolios/) pages.

For specific service information, refer to the [Web Design](https://sharkeymedia.com/web-design/), [Web Hosting & SEO](https://sharkeymedia.com/web-hosting-seo/), and [Media Production](https://sharkeymedia.com/media-production/) pages.
